tools.name: grafana_get_current_user
tools.description: Return the user or service account behind the token: id, login, name, the current orgId and the Grafana admin flag. Use it to check which token is in use. Grafana API: GET /api/user.

tools.name: grafana_get_current_org
tools.description: Return the organization the token belongs to: id, name and address. Grafana API: GET /api/org.

tools.name: grafana_search
tools.description: Search dashboards and folders by title, tag or folder. Each result has uid, title, type, url and folderUid. Good first call to find a dashboard uid. Grafana API: GET /api/search.

tools.name: grafana_get_dashboard
tools.description: Return one dashboard by uid: its JSON model (panels, queries, variables) and metadata (version, folder, updated). Large dashboards return a large result. Grafana API: GET /api/dashboards/uid/{uid}.

tools.name: grafana_list_folders
tools.description: List dashboard folders: uid, title and url. Use parent_uid to list nested folders. Grafana API: GET /api/folders.

tools.name: grafana_list_datasources
tools.description: List the data sources of the stack: uid, name, type (for example prometheus or loki) and default flag. Use a uid with grafana_query_data. Grafana API: GET /api/datasources.

tools.name: grafana_get_datasource
tools.description: Return one data source by uid: name, type, url and settings (secrets are not returned). Grafana API: GET /api/datasources/uid/{uid}.

tools.name: grafana_query_data
tools.description: Run one or more queries against data sources (metrics, logs, traces) and return the frames. Each query names its datasource uid and the query text for that type, for example {refId, datasource:{uid}, expr} for Prometheus. Grafana API: POST /api/ds/query.

tools.name: grafana_list_org_users
tools.description: List users and their roles in the current organization. Filter by text with query. Grafana API: GET /api/org/users.

tools.name: grafana_list_teams
tools.description: Search teams by name: id, uid, name, memberCount and email. Grafana API: GET /api/teams/search.

tools.name: grafana_list_annotations
tools.description: List annotations (events on graphs) in a time range, optionally for one dashboard or tag. Times are epoch ms. Grafana API: GET /api/annotations.

tools.name: grafana_create_annotation
tools.description: Add an event to a dashboard or to the stack: text, time, optional end time, tags and an optional dashboard uid and panel id. Writes data. Grafana API: POST /api/annotations.

tools.name: grafana_list_alert_rules
tools.description: List all alert rules of the stack with uid, title, folder, rule group, condition and labels. Grafana API: GET /api/v1/provisioning/alert-rules.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "grafana_get_datasource" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return one data source by uid: name, type, url and settings (secrets are not returned). Grafana API: GET /api/datasources/uid/{uid}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: grafana_search, grafana_list_folders, grafana_get_datasource, grafana_list_teams · Private data: grafana_get_current_user, grafana_get_current_org, grafana_get_datasource · Public sink: grafana_query_data, grafana_list_teams, grafana_create_annotation · Destructive: grafana_query_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: grafana_search, grafana_list_folders, grafana_get_datasource, grafana_list_teams · Private data: grafana_get_current_user, grafana_get_current_org, grafana_get_datasource · Public sink: grafana_query_data, grafana_list_teams, grafana_create_annotation · Destructive: grafana_query_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
